outcome: safety of telemedicine visits (missed clinical findings)
utilization of visit types (in-person vs. telemedicine)
cohort: The study included 612 patients, predominantly 5-10 years old females, who were new referrals for pediatric lower urinary tract symptoms (pLUTS) to a pediatric urology clinic between September 2018 and August 2021.
finding: Pediatric LUTS care can be safely delivered via telemedicine, with shorter wait times compared to in-person visits, and without significant changes in patient volume or population, as the in-person exam can be omitted safely with proper clinical history taking.
